examples.explanation: One lit lamp sets either one minute bit or one hour bit.
At most 8 lamps can ever be lit, so 9 has no reading.
With nothing lit the watch reads 0:00.

hints: Try every hour 0..11 and minute 0..59 and count set bits.
A pair fits when the two popcounts add up to turnedOn.
Format minutes with two digits via %02d-style padding.
title: 475. Binary Watch
